title: PostToolUse (Write|Edit) hook input — fields consumed by post_edit_tests.py
description: Claude Code delivers a larger payload on stdin; this schema documents only the fields this hook reads. Unknown fields are ignored. The hook runs `pytest -k <file stem> -q` when the edited file is a .py under pi_script/, rift/, or moltbook/ relative to cwd; anything else is a no-op.

cwd.description: Project directory the session is running in; used to resolve the edited file's repo-relative path.

file_path.description: Absolute path of the file that was written or edited.

x-exit-codes.0: no tests run (out of scope), or targeted tests passed, or pytest collected nothing for -k (pytest exit 5)
x-exit-codes.2: targeted tests failed; the pytest tail on stderr is fed back to the model
